name: Manuel Aguilar y Bustamante
contribution: A Salvadoran ecclesiastic and revolutionary against the Spanish Empire who participated in the 1811 Independence Movement and the 1814 Independence Movement.

checks.lead: Manuel Aguilar y Bustamante (26 June 1750 – 25 May 1819) was a Salvadoran ecclesiastic and revolutionary against the Spanish Empire who participated in the 1811 Independence Movement and the 1814 Independence Movement.
